specification.problem: Compute the ground-state energy of minimal-basis HeH+ as a function of bond distance (bond dissociation curve) on a solid-state NV-center quantum register in diamond, using a quantum algorithm for molecular energies.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Abstract-level reconstruction of a small quantum chemistry experiment on an NV-center register; the specific algorithm, Hamiltonian coefficients, circuits and measurement details are not given in the abstract and are only labeled background or assumption.

symbols.meaning: Qubit-encoded electronic Hamiltonian of minimal-basis HeH+ at bond distance R
symbols.domain: Hermitian operator on a few qubits

symbols.meaning: Ground-state energy giving the dissociation curve point

equations.label: Ground-state energy
equations.description: Ground-state energy of the molecular Hamiltonian at each bond distance, by the variational principle, as a basis for the dissociation curve.
equations.justification: Standard electronic structure and variational principle; the abstract states only that the bond dissociation curve is computed. It is not confirmed as the paper's method.
assumptions: Energy is obtained via a variational or phase-estimation-type method; the abstract does not specify which.

equations.label: Reported uncertainty scale
equations.description: Reported energy uncertainty given the model basis.
equations.abstract_quote: energy uncertainty (given our model basis) of the order of $10^{-14}$ Hartree

registers.name: system
registers.role: Encodes the minimal-basis HeH+ electronic state, e.g. NV electron spin plus nuclear spin

registers.name: ancilla
registers.role: Possible readout or phase-estimation qubit; not specified in the abstract

specification.initial_state: Assumed reference state |00> (or Hartree-Fock-like product state) on the system register.

steps.description: For each bond distance R, build the qubit Hamiltonian H(R) for minimal-basis HeH+ (assumed precomputed classically).
Prepare the ground-state estimate on the NV register with assumed algorithm-specific control pulses (a variational ansatz or controlled time evolution under H(R)).
Extract the energy estimate E_0(R) at each R and trace out the dissociation curve, compared against the stated uncertainty scale.

specification.measurement: Assumed: read out the NV register spin states (optical readout of the electron spin, with nuclear spin readout mapped to it). Expectation values of Hamiltonian terms or phase-estimation outcomes are estimated from repeated runs.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Assumed: combine measured expectation values with Hamiltonian coefficients (or convert phase to energy), then sweep R to form the dissociation curve and estimate the uncertainty \Delta E.
assumptions: Minimal-basis HeH+ is mapped to a small qubit Hamiltonian.
Register sizes, initial state, circuit steps and measurement scheme are assumed generic, not taken from the abstract.
Two-qubit system register assumed; optional ancilla.
